findings.observation: The fixture finder protects app/config/review, requires copy-root origins and exact pins before compile/exec, and refuses missing protected module specs. The separately installed native loader owns hedgehog/demo and its 88-entry finite native/resource map.

Both dynamic_wire.py and native_cases.py use only stdlib top-level imports and are hash-loaded as separate admitted helper refs. The fixture invokes create_wire_client/product_factory, never native_cases.run_cases or its fixed historical source-reader fixture.

Fresh TaskStore rows and native controllers use the actual TaskStore.source_reader closure; no pinned raw-reader replacement or JSON-restored controller/ExperienceBinding. The explicit wall-clock tick read retains timestamps and proves content identity projection separately.

The admitted existing .venv-plan/bin/python -I -B route is required; the proposal explicitly omits -S so jsonschema and its accepted environment closure remain available. Harness refs are separate from the 180 application runtime pins.
The frozen helper requires actual BLOCKED_FAIL_CLOSED plus false permission_created, final_output_created and effect_requested, not merely a non-ACCEPT branch.

final_cutoff disables the timer before raising. If it fires inside run_current cleanup while a primary exception already exists, the broad secondary-error catch can continue to another cleanup call before main re-arms. The primary reviewer and author were asked to prevent swallowing an expired hard cutoff. This scoped review grants no execution.

scope: Read-only importer, dependency layout and source-reader wiring review; not acceptance of reviewer-authored G4 application code or a runtime result.
